/srv/apps/example-app--scrumux-t-0016-7318538e/.claude/scripts/scrumux issue new --type harness --source implement-sop \
  --summary "block-secret-reads.mjs fires on 'scrumux log new --did ...' when the free-text --did/--verified prose contains the substring '.env' (e.g. 'ran it with no .env/checkout mounted'), even though the command reads no file at all — it is a log-record write, not a credential read." \
  --fix "block-secret-reads.mjs should only match Bash commands that actually target a credential/secret file path (cat/less/grep/etc against .env or similar), not scan unrelated argument text for the substring '.env'. At minimum, exempt 'scrumux log new'/'scrumux task' invocations, whose --did/--verified/--summary values are narrative evidence text, never a file read."
